key_insight: The paper improves offline RL by using uncertainty to choose safer preference queries and to adapt regularization during policy learning.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to make offline policy optimization more stable and data-efficient when expert feedback is available but environment interaction is not.
method: Estimate action uncertainty with a Morse network relative to the offline dataset.
Query preferences conservatively for actions near the dataset to preserve Bellman-update stability.
Apply uncertainty-aware adaptive regularization to dynamically tune constraints during policy optimization, integrated with CQL.
evidence_signal: The framework is evaluated extensively on the D4RL benchmark and reports superior or competitive performance across a wide range of tasks.
watch_item: Performance depends on uncertainty estimation quality, so miscalibration could weaken query selection and regularization control.
paper_title: Conservative Query and Adaptive Regularization for Offline RL Under Uncertainty Estimation
